alert.message: Whisper OOM loop detected & stopped. Omiximo/Lidaros network issues.
alert.action: Whisper was in a 932k restart loop due to CUDA Out of Memory (VRAM fully allocated by VLLM). I have STOPPED the whisper process to prevent further CPU/log thrashing. Omiximo is failing because 'inventree-server' is unreachable from within the container network.
